records.name: ANIMUS CURSE
records.description: After a CRYPTEK model is destroyed, friendly NECRONS models can re-roll Hit rolls against the attacking unit for the rest of the battle.

records.name: BLOOD-FUELLED CRUELTY
records.description: When an enemy Falls Back from a DESTROYER CULT or Flayed Ones unit, inflict possible mortal wounds and then make a Normal move that closes on that enemy.

records.name: CHRONODISTORTION
records.description: When a NECRONS unit is attacked in Fight, destroyed models that have not fought can fight before removal on a 4+, improved when the attacker is unravelling.

records.name: CHRONOSHIFT
records.description: A non-TITANIC NECRONS VEHICLE or MOUNTED unit that Advances adds a flat 6 inches to Move instead of rolling.

records.name: Command Re-roll
records.when: Any phase, just after you make an eligible roll for a friendly unit or model.
records.effect: Re-roll that roll; for multi-dice rolls, re-roll one die except Charge rolls, which are re-rolled in full.
records.target: That friendly unit or model.
records.description: Re-roll one eligible roll for a friendly unit or model.

records.name: Counteroffensive
records.when: Fight step of your opponent's Fight phase, just after an enemy unit resolves its attacks.
records.effect: Until the end of the phase, that unit has Fights First and must be the next unit you select to fight.
records.target: One friendly unit that is eligible to fight.
records.description: After an enemy fights, make one eligible friendly unit fight next.

records.name: Crushing Impact
records.when: Your Charge phase, just after a friendly MONSTER or VEHICLE unit ends a Charge move.
records.effect: Choose an engaged enemy and one engaged model from your unit; roll D6 equal to that model's Toughness, risking mortal wounds to your unit on 1s and dealing mortal wounds to the enemy on 5+, up to 6.
records.target: That MONSTER or VEHICLE unit.
records.description: After a MONSTER or VEHICLE charges, use its Toughness to attempt mortal wounds against an engaged enemy, with some risk to itself.

records.name: Epic Challenge
records.when: Fight phase, just after a friendly CHARACTER unit is selected to fight.
records.effect: Choose one CHARACTER model in the unit; its melee weapons gain PRECISION until the end of the phase.
records.target: That CHARACTER unit.
records.description: Give one CHARACTER model PRECISION on its melee weapons for the Fight phase.

records.name: Explosives
records.when: Your Shooting phase.
records.effect: Choose an eligible model and visible enemy within 8 inches; roll six D6 and inflict 1 mortal wound for each 4+.
records.target: One friendly unengaged EXPLOSIVES or GRENADES unit that is eligible to shoot and did not Advance this turn.
records.description: An eligible EXPLOSIVES/GRENADES unit can inflict mortal wounds on a nearby visible enemy.

records.name: Fire Overwatch
records.when: End of your opponent's Movement phase.
records.effect: That unit shoots using snap shooting.
records.target: One friendly unengaged unit, excluding TITANIC units.
records.description: At the end of the opponent's Movement phase, an eligible unit can fire using snap shooting.

records.name: Heroic Intervention
records.when: End of your opponent's Charge phase.
records.effect: Resolve a charge with the unit using one of the Stratagem's permitted intervention modes.
records.target: One friendly unengaged unit within 12 inches of an enemy; VEHICLE targets must be CHARACTER or WALKER units.
records.description: At the end of the opponent's Charge phase, an eligible nearby unit can make a reactive charge.

records.name: Insane Bravery
records.when: Battle-shock step of your Command phase, just before a friendly unit makes a Battle-shock roll.
records.effect: The Battle-shock roll is automatically successful.
records.target: That friendly unit.
records.description: Automatically pass one Battle-shock roll; once per battle.

records.name: New Orders
records.when: End of your Command phase.
records.effect: Discard that card and draw a new Secondary Mission card.
records.target: One active Secondary Mission card.
records.description: Replace one active Secondary Mission at the end of your Command phase.

records.name: Rapid Ingress
records.when: End of your opponent's Movement phase.
records.effect: That unit makes an ingress move. Cannot be used during the first battle round.
records.target: One friendly unit in Strategic Reserves, excluding AIRCRAFT.
records.description: Bring an eligible Strategic Reserves unit in at the end of the opponent's Movement phase; not in round 1.

records.name: Smokescreen
records.when: Start of your opponent's Shooting phase.
records.effect: Until the end of the phase, qualifying targets obscured by that SMOKE unit receive the Benefit of Cover.
records.target: One friendly SMOKE unit.
records.description: Use a SMOKE unit to grant the Benefit of Cover against qualifying ranged attacks for the phase.

records.name: COSMIC PRECISION
records.description: A non-MONSTER NECRONS unit arriving by Deep Strike or Hyperphasing can set up more than 6 inches from enemies, but cannot charge that turn.

records.name: Cosmic Storm
records.description: When an Obelisk or Tesseract Vault shoots, its Tesla Sphere weapons gain +1 AP for that shooting.

records.name: COUNTERTEMPORAL SHIFT
records.description: A targeted CANOPTEK unit can only be selected by ranged attacks from models within 18 inches for the rest of the phase.

records.name: CURSE OF THE CRYPTEK
records.description: After a CRYPTEK model is destroyed, friendly CANOPTEK models gain +1 to Hit and +1 to Wound against the unit that killed it for the rest of the battle.

records.name: CYNOSURE OF ERADICATION
records.description: A CRYPTEK or CANOPTEK unit wholly inside the Power Matrix gains DEVASTATING WOUNDS for the phase.

records.name: DIMENSIONAL CORRIDOR
records.description: A NECRONS unit that arrived through a MONOLITH Eternity Gate this turn becomes eligible to charge this phase.

records.name: DIMENSIONAL TUNNEL
records.description: A non-TITANIC NECRONS VEHICLE or MOUNTED unit can move horizontally through models and terrain for the phase.

records.name: DISHARMONISATION CASCADE
records.description: When a NECRONS MONSTER is destroyed, its Deadly Demise triggers mortal wounds on a 3+ instead of only on a 6 for that resolution.

records.name: Dominance Protocols
records.when: Your Command phase.
records.effect: That unit has +1 Objective Control until the end of the turn.
records.target: One friendly Immortals unit.
records.description: Give one Immortals unit +1 OC until the end of the turn.

records.name: DRIVEN TO BUTCHERY
records.when: Your Shooting phase or your Charge phase.
records.effect: Until the end of the turn, the unit can shoot and declare a charge even if it Advanced.
records.target: One DESTROYER CULT unit from your army.
records.description: A DESTROYER CULT unit can shoot and charge after Advancing this turn; usable once per turn.

records.name: ENDLESS SERVITUDE
records.description: At the end of your Fight phase, a qualifying NECRONS unit on an objective you control activates Reanimation Protocols.

records.name: ENSLAVED ARTIFICE
records.description: A non-TITANIC NECRONS unit scores Critical Hits on unmodified Hit rolls of 5+ for the phase.

records.name: ENTROPHASIC AURA TARGETING
records.description: A non-MONSTER NECRONS unit re-rolls Hit rolls of 1 for the phase and also re-rolls Wound rolls of 1 against unravelling targets.

records.name: ENTROPIC DAMPING
records.description: When a nearby TITANIC model is targeted in Shooting, the attacking unit’s weapons gain HAZARDOUS for the phase.

records.name: Evasive Protocols
records.description: When a NECRONS MOUNTED unit is targeted in Shooting, attacks with Strength greater than its Toughness suffer -1 to Wound.

records.name: HYPERPHASIC RECALL
records.description: After a NECRONS INFANTRY unit loses models to an attack, relocate it to within 6 inches of a friendly MONOLITH and outside Engagement Range.

records.name: IMAGE OF DEATH
records.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit selects targets.
records.effect: Until the end of the phase, subtract 1 from Hit rolls for attacks that target your unit.
records.target: One DESTROYER CULT unit selected as a target of that enemy unit.
records.description: After an enemy selects a DESTROYER CULT unit as a target in Shooting or Fight, attacks into that unit suffer -1 to Hit for the phase.

records.name: INSANITY’S IRE
records.description: After an enemy shoots a friendly unengaged DESTROYER CULT or Flayed Ones unit, that unit can make a D6-inch surge move.

records.name: MASKS OF DEATH
records.description: Protect a targeted DESTROYER CULT or Flayed Ones unit: attacks against it suffer -1 to Hit for the phase.

records.name: MASS TRANSMOGRIFICATION
records.description: After a NECRONS MONSTER destroys an unravelling enemy, a nearby friendly non-MONSTER NECRONS unit activates Reanimation Protocols.

records.name: MERCILESS RECLAMATION
records.description: A non-MONSTER, non-TITANIC NECRONS unit gains +1 to Wound against targets within range of objective markers for the phase.

records.name: METHODICAL MURDER
records.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
records.effect: Until the end of the phase, weapons equipped by models in that unit gain SUSTAINED HITS 1.
records.target: One NECRONS unit, excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES, that has not shot or fought this phase.
records.description: Use in your Shooting or Fight phase on an eligible non-Monster/non-Vehicle NECRONS unit that has not acted; its weapons gain SUSTAINED HITS 1 for the phase.

records.name: MICROSCARAB SWARM
records.description: Protect a CRYPTEK INFANTRY unit being attacked: NECRON WARRIORS gain a 5+ invulnerable save, while IMMORTALS gain a 4+ invulnerable save for the phase.

records.name: MOLECULAR EROSION
records.description: A NECRONS MONSTER forces one visible unravelling enemy unit to take a Battle-shock test at -1; if failed, it suffers D3+1 mortal wounds.

records.name: MOLECULAR TARGETING
records.description: A NECRONS unit can ignore modifiers to Ballistic/Weapon Skill and Hit rolls for the phase; CRYPTEK units can also ignore Wound-roll modifiers.

records.name: MORTIS PROTOCOLS
records.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after the first DESTROYER CULT unit from your army destroys an enemy unit this turn.
records.effect: The targeted friendly unit activates Reanimation Protocols.
records.target: One friendly NECRONS unit, excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES, within 9 inches of that DESTROYER CULT unit.
records.description: After your first DESTROYER CULT kill of the turn, a nearby eligible NECRONS unit activates Reanimation Protocols.

records.name: MURDEROUS REANIMATION
records.description: After a DESTROYER CULT or Flayed Ones unit destroys an enemy or pushes it Below Half-strength, activate that unit’s Reanimation Protocols.

records.name: NANOASSEMBLY PROTOCOLS
records.description: A targeted NECRONS VEHICLE reduces the Damage characteristic of incoming attacks by 1 for the phase.

records.name: Nanosaturation
records.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, after an enemy unit that targeted a friendly Immortals or Necron Warriors unit has shot.
records.effect: The unit can shoot using snap shooting, but can only target that enemy unit.
records.target: That Immortals or Necron Warriors unit.
records.description: After being shot, an Immortals or Necron Warriors unit can return fire using snap shooting against the attacker.

records.name: Omnilocked Strafing
records.description: A NECRONS MOUNTED unit that Falls Back remains eligible to shoot.

records.name: Particle Pulse
records.description: At the start of Shooting, a NECRONS TITANIC FLY unit marks one visible enemy within 12 inches; that enemy’s detection range increases by 3 inches.

records.name: PHASE MELDING
records.description: When an unravelling enemy Falls Back from a NECRONS unit, every model in that enemy unit must take a Desperate Escape test, with a penalty if Battle-shocked.

records.name: PITILESS HUNTERS
records.description: A DESTROYER CULT or Flayed Ones unit can make Pile-in and Consolidation moves of up to 6 inches for the phase.

records.name: POTENTIALITY SYPHON
records.description: During the opponent’s Command phase, a NECRONS unit on an objective activates Reanimation Protocols; CRYPTEK units reanimate one additional wound.

records.name: PROTOCOL OF THE CONQUERING TYRANT
records.description: A shooting NECRONS unit re-rolls Hit rolls of 1 against targets within half range; if led by a NECRONS CHARACTER, it can re-roll the Hit roll instead.

records.name: PROTOCOL OF THE ETERNAL REVENANT
records.description: Return a just-destroyed NECRONS INFANTRY CHARACTER at the end of the phase with half its starting wounds; each model can use this once per battle.

records.name: PROTOCOL OF THE HUNGRY VOID
records.description: Give a NECRONS unit +1 Strength on melee weapons for the phase; if led by a NECRONS CHARACTER, also improve melee AP by 1.

records.name: PROTOCOL OF THE SUDDEN STORM
records.description: Give a NECRONS unit ASSAULT on ranged weapons for the turn; if led by a NECRONS CHARACTER, also re-roll its Advance roll.

records.name: PROTOCOL OF THE UNDYING LEGIONS
records.description: After an enemy attack destroys models in a NECRONS unit, activate Reanimation Protocols for D3 wounds, or D3+1 if a NECRONS CHARACTER is leading it.

records.name: PROTOCOL OF THE VENGEFUL STARS
records.description: After an enemy destroys a NECRONS unit in Shooting, a nearby NECRONS CHARACTER unit can shoot back at that attacker.

records.name: QUANTUM DEFLECTION
records.description: A targeted NECRONS VEHICLE unit gains a 4+ invulnerable save for the phase.

records.name: REACTIVE REPOSITION
records.description: After a non-MONSTER, non-TITANIC NECRONS unit is shot, it can make a Normal move of up to D6 inches.

records.name: REACTIVE SUBROUTINES
records.description: After a nearby enemy finishes a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move, a CANOPTEK unit within 8 inches can make a Normal move of up to 6 inches.

records.name: REANIMATION CRYPTS
records.description: In your Command phase, each of your NECRONS units in Reserves activates its Reanimation Protocols.

records.name: SENTINELS OF ETERNITY
records.description: Destroyed LYCHGUARD or TRIARCH PRAETORIANS that have not fought can fight on a 4+ before being removed.

records.name: SOLAR PULSE
records.description: At the start of Shooting, a CRYPTEK designates a nearby objective; friendly NECRONS attacks against units near that objective gain IGNORES COVER for the phase.

records.name: SPREADING MADNESS
records.when: Your Charge phase.
records.effect: Until the end of the phase, add 2 to its Charge roll when at least one charge target is already within Engagement Range of a friendly unit.
records.target: One NECRONS unit, excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES, that has not declared a charge this phase.
records.description: Give an eligible NECRONS unit +2 to qualifying Charge rolls into enemies already engaged by your army.

records.name: SUBOPTIMAL FACADE
records.description: When a CANOPTEK unit wholly within the Power Matrix is declared as a charge target, activate its Reanimation Protocols.

records.name: Subsurface Quantumweave
records.description: When a NECRONS TITANIC FLY unit is targeted, incoming attacks have 1 worse AP until that enemy unit finishes attacking.

records.name: SUFFER NO RIVAL
records.description: A LYCHGUARD or TRIARCH unit gains PRECISION on its melee weapons for the Fight phase.

records.name: Swift As Death
records.description: After an enemy ends a move within 8 inches of a friendly unengaged NECRONS MOUNTED unit, that unit can make a Normal move of D3+3 inches.

records.name: SYNERGISTIC EMPOWERMENT
records.description: At the start of Shooting, a CRYPTEK unit grants the CRYPTEK keyword for the phase to one nearby friendly NECRONS model that is not a MONSTER or VEHICLE.

records.name: TERRITORIAL OBSESSION
records.description: A LYCHGUARD or TRIARCH unit gains +1 OC until your next Command phase; VEHICLE units gain +3 OC instead.

records.name: THE SPOOR OF FRAILTY
records.description: Boost a DESTROYER CULT or Flayed Ones unit against damaged enemies: +1 to Hit below Starting Strength and +1 to Wound as well when the target is Below Half-strength.

records.name: UNNATURAL AGGRESSION
records.when: End of your opponent's Charge phase.
records.effect: That unit declares and resolves a charge against one or more of those enemy units; it gains no Charge bonus from doing so.
records.target: One eligible NECRONS unit, excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES, within 6 inches of one or more enemy units.
records.description: At the end of the opponent's Charge phase, an eligible nearby NECRONS unit can make a reactive charge, without receiving a Charge bonus.

records.name: UNTAPPED POWER
records.description: A CRYPTEK unit selected to shoot can choose one additional Technosorcerous Augmentations weapon ability for the phase.

records.name: UNYIELDING FORMS
records.description: A non-TITANIC NECRONS VEHICLE or MOUNTED unit gains -1 to incoming Wound rolls when attack Strength exceeds its Toughness.

records.name: Will of the Conqueror
records.when: End of your Movement phase.
records.effect: Select one objective marker that unit controls; that objective is secured.
records.target: One friendly Immortals or Necron Warriors unit.
records.description: At the end of Movement, an Immortals or Necron Warriors unit can secure an objective it controls.

records.name: YOUR TIME IS NIGH
records.description: After the enemy WARLORD is destroyed, your NECRONS WARLORD imposes -1 on enemy Battle-shock and Leadership tests for the rest of the battle.
